bundleable_sources.name: New General Service List
bundleable_sources.purpose: learner rank and core vocabulary candidate selection
bundleable_sources.publication_rule: Rank is learning priority, never a CEFR level. Preserve source URL, version, license, and any source-specific learner band on learner_entries.

bundleable_sources.name: NGSL Graded Reader List
bundleable_sources.purpose: secondary frequency bands for staged reading vocabulary
bundleable_sources.publication_rule: Treat bands as source-specific bands; do not relabel them as CEFR.

bundleable_sources.name: Open English WordNet
bundleable_sources.purpose: stable sense keys and English sense-definition backbone
bundleable_sources.derived_from: Princeton WordNet under the WordNet License
bundleable_sources.publication_rule: Use only as source evidence. Keep the source sense key, version, artifact checksum, source URL, and license on every derived learner sense. OEWN lemma matches and source order require human semantic selection; they are never automatic publication or learner order.

bundleable_sources.name: CEFR-Annotated WordNet
bundleable_sources.purpose: provisional CEFR candidate labels for exact WordNet senses
bundleable_sources.publication_rule: Automated labels remain staging hints. Record source URL, snapshot version, license, confidence, and evidence basis, then require human sense-level review before publication.

reference_only_sources.name: English Vocabulary Profile
reference_only_sources.storage_rule: Do not scrape, bulk-copy, or persist entries without a separate license or API agreement.

reference_only_sources.name: Oxford learner word lists
reference_only_sources.storage_rule: Do not bundle copied definitions, examples, pronunciations, or level labels without permission.
